node.title: Re^2: Calculating holidays
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Source code if you want to implement something similar Source (raw)

That's a hard-coded list of dates from 1997 to 2025... not an implementation I'd recommend. Plus, they're [https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/5/6103|US Federal Holidays] and don't always fall on the same day as the actual holiday. For example, this year, New Year's Day was observed on Jaunary 2nd.
